verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's official CLI is documented for running API tests from a terminal or automated system, and its `hopp test` command runs whole collections and can produce a JUnit report, which is a standard pass/fail format. Test-case scripting is also referenced in the docs. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of test assertions and the pass/fail summary output, no evidence of an in-app collection runner, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
